Name: Four Seasons Farm
Author: JustChaldea
Description:
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]
A single-map farm where each of the four seasons lives in its own zone year-round. Spring glade, summer cove, autumn orchard, and a snowy winter peak share one continuous landscape, divided by a river system that runs between them.

Built to be played with the Four Seasons Total Landscaping mod, which makes each zone behave like its own season. Crops grow only in their matching zone, weather and fishing key off the zone the player is standing in, footstep sounds match the ground per zone, and the farmhouse picks up the lighting of whichever zone it sits in.

[size=5][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0 or newer if you don't already have it.[/*]
[*]Install Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Install the Four Seasons Total Landscaping mod. This farm needs it to function correctly.[/*]
[*]Drop the [CP] FourSeasonsLandscaping folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Start a new save and pick Four Seasons Farm at character creation.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Four permanent seasonal zones[/b] in one continuous map: a spring glade, a summer cove, a autumn orchard, and a snowy winter peak.[/*]
[*][b]River system[/b] flowing between zones with a lake between the fall-summer-spring zone.[/*]
[*][b]Compatible with seasonal recolour mods.[/b] Since each zone keeps its painted palette regardless of calendar season, recolour mods apply per-zone simultaneously rather than swapping the whole farm on day rollover.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0 or newer[/b] (Stardew Valley 1.6 or later).[/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher 2.5.0 or newer.[/b][/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45664]Four Seasons Total Landscaping mod.[/url][/b][/*]
[/list]
